stories.title: Storms postpone Macy's Thanksgiving Parade for first time, cancel hundreds of flights
new_facts: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday for the first time because of a storm; Macy's gave an on-record statement.
Parade has a 100-year history; first postponement was made jointly by Macy's and New York City after forecasts.
Storm brought heavy rain and 50+ mph wind gusts to the D.C. region overnight.
Hundreds of flights canceled on Thanksgiving Day; separate question swirls over an Iowa detonation.
Storms with high tides and floods expected to affect travel for an estimated 81.5 million people.
stories.line: A Thanksgiving storm forced Macy's to postpone its parade for the first time ever, and hundreds of flights were canceled.

stories.title: Trump approves SpaceX plan for up to one million orbital data center satellites
new_facts: Trump administration authorised SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites for space-based data centres; experts warn of catastrophic effects.
Musk and SpaceX to give every US child two SpaceX shares via Trump Accounts, doubling pledge, worth ~$18.4B.
stories.line: SpaceX plans to launch up to a million satellites for orbital data centers, which experts warn could harm the planet.

new_facts: FIFA confirmed a cyberattack in which a hacking group impersonated staff and stole personal and business data, including immigration documents and financial records.
stories.line: Hackers impersonating staff stole personal and business data from FIFA, including reportedly immigration documents and financial records.

stories.title: Country musician Ketch Secor urges artists to break silence on assault rifles after Nashville shooting
stories.line: After the Nashville school shooting, country musician Ketch Secor is urging fellow artists to speak out on gun violence despite fear of fan backlash.

stories.title: Trump unveils new tariffs on 14 trade partners over industrial overcapacity
new_facts: White House calls Iowa explosives detonation a success with no health impact; proposes sweeping tariffs on 11 countries plus EU and China.
Global stocks rallied as investors shrugged off the new tariffs and AI jitters, buying bargains.
Tariffs target 14 partners over industrial overcapacity, with proposed maximum rates of 20-40%, despite GOP midterm losses.
Some countries are offered lower tariff rates if they secure trade deals with Washington.
stories.line: The Trump administration announced new tariffs on 14 trade partners over alleged unfair industrial overcapacity, pressuring them toward trade deals.
